channel.title: Farrelly Atkinson Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Farrelly Atkinson Limited (road.cc)

item.title: 100% Brisker Xtreme Gloves
item.description: Well-made, affordable gloves that feel nice until the temperature drops

item.title: “Anyone who thinks one metre is suitable has never been overtaken by a truck”: Drivers in New Zealand could be fined $3,000 for close passing cyclists
item.description: Under the proposed new laws, motorists could be fined for leaving less than a metre when passing cyclists, which the government says will balance safety and “efficient use of the roads” – but opponents have branded the move “dangerous”

item.title: Princeton CarbonWorks unveils new Wake 6560 Evolution II, claiming: “fastest UCI-legal wheel we’ve tested”
item.description: The sixth-generation flagship wheel from Princeton CarbonWorks features a hooked rim that’s both wider and lighter than previously, and comes with a premium price tag

item.title: Council “scaling back underused cycle lane” to allow more cars on busy route and make “best possible use of road space we have”
item.description: “There is a lot of pressure on the road network around Reading,” the local authority said, blaming the apparent failure of the bike lane on a lack of funding to connect it to other routes

item.title: “We believe our combination is safe”: Cadex sticks with hookless for new Max 50 WheelSystem and Aero Tyre
item.description: The Max 50 WheelSystem and Aero Tyre are said to deliver “a measurable aerodynamic advantage in real-world conditions,” with the 50 mm wheelset weighing a claimed 1,290g and costing £3,499.98

item.title: ‘No, I’m not the new Cycling Mikey’: Britain’s most infamous camera cyclist councillor on holding bad drivers to account, dealing with trolls, and not caring what the Daily Mail thinks
item.description: “I’m trying to make things safer for people on the road and if they don’t like it, then that’s their problem”

item.title: Dynamic AirForce Max blower
item.description: Nicely built and impressively powerful – if loud – but it's not enough to genuinely dry a chain

item.title: “Stop spending money on useless cycle lanes”: local media publishes residents’ angry claims without verification; Hope after all? Surveys show next generation of cyclists back new infrastructure despite safety concerns + more on the live blog
item.description: If you're not a politico who stayed up for the by-election last night, you should be awake enough to join Callum through his Friday internet trawl. It's the least you can do...

item.title: “If I hadn’t had it on, maybe I wouldn’t be here today”: Zoe Bäckstedt recalls horror crash which smashed helmet “into so many pieces”
item.description: British rider, who suffered a broken hand and wrist in the training crash, says she now wears a helmet "everywhere I go"

item.title: “Clear anti-cyclist bias”: Lawsuit filed against Toronto police after cop doored cyclist… before ticketing rider over incident
item.description: Cyclist's lawyer questions why rider was blamed for "riding too fast for the conditions" and not wearing a helmet
